title: How to use Cursor AI to 10x your coding speed

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if Cursor AI could let developers write entire applications in seconds — but at what cost?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Cursor AI uses code generation and context-aware completion, slashing repetitive tasks and accelerating iteration cycles.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But automation could displace developers, eroding job markets and deepening the skills gap between elite and average coders.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on augmentation — tools that assist, not replace — and emphasizing upskilling through AI-powered learning platforms.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI handles boilerplate, freeing developers to innovate on complex, human-centric problems.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t about replacing humans — it’s about redefining what’s possible when human and machine collaborate.

video_cue: A developer typing rapidly on a keyboard as lines of code auto-generate on the screen, with a glowing AI interface in the corner.
